verdict.rationale: The evidence pack lists Bevy's built-in features (ECS, rendering, animation, audio, UI, scenes) but contains no mention of rigid-body physics, collision detection, or raycasting as first-party/built-in capabilities. The only physics-adjacent reference is a third-party asset/plugin ecosystem page, implying physics is added via external crates (e.g., community plugins) rather than shipping out of the box.
